herrenschloss.name: Herrenchiemsee New Palace
herrenschloss.slogan: A king's Versailles, built on an island and never finished.
herrenschloss.line: Construction began on 21 May 1878, and Ludwig II stayed only a few days in September 1885.

koenigsseeboot.name: Königssee
koenigsseeboot.slogan: Silent electric boats and a trumpet that answers from the cliffs.
koenigsseeboot.line: Only electric-powered passenger ships, rowing boats and pedal boats have been allowed on the lake since 1909.

frauenwoerth.name: Fraueninsel
frauenwoerth.slogan: A car-free island where nuns have prayed since the Carolingians.
frauenwoerth.line: Duke Tassilo III founded the Frauenwörth convent here in 782, and a lime tree on the island is estimated to be over 1,000 years old.

maxjosefplatz.name: Max-Josefs-Platz
maxjosefplatz.slogan: Rosenheim's old market square, arcaded and rebuilt after the fire.
maxjosefplatz.line: The houses around the square were rebuilt after the great fire of 1641, though their cores partly date to the 14th and 15th centuries.

lokschuppen.name: Lokschuppen
lokschuppen.slogan: Locomotives left; blockbuster exhibitions rolled into the roundhouse.
lokschuppen.line: The former railway roundhouse has hosted annually changing exhibitions since the centre opened in 1988.
